candidates.candidate: 一遭在空中飛来飛去， 一邊四處打需引發森林大火， 因此受到嚴惡。
candidates.paddleCandidate: 一邊在空中飛來飛去 一邊四處打雷引發森林大火 因此受到販燈

candidates.english: It latches on to prey with its sucker mouth, sinking in its fangs and shocking the prey with powerful electricity.
candidates.candidate: 會用吸壁的矚吸刚在 財手身上，然後刻這 牙國放出強大的電流。
candidates.paddleCandidate: 會用吸盤的嘴吸附在對手身上，然後刺瑪牙縮放出強大的電流

candidates.english: These Pokémon have a big appetite. When they spot their prey, they attack it and paralyze it with electricity.
candidates.candidate: 食悠旺盛的寶可夢。 一發現練物就會發動襲擊， 用電流使其麻您後大快朵颐。
candidates.paddleCandidate: 食感旺盛的實可夢 一發現物就會發動腦擊 用電流使其麻痺後大快朵顧

candidates.english: These Pokémon move in schools. They have an electricity-generating organ, so they discharge electricity if in danger.
candidates.candidate: 集醒行動的寶可夢。 擁有製遠電力的器容， 遇到危機時魷會發電。

candidates.english: A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek pouches together in an effort to share stored electricity.
candidates.candidate: 有時候可以見到 為了將盤存的電力分鹉同伴 而互相摩猴颊囊的帕奇利茲。
candidates.paddleCandidate: 有時候可以見到為了將儲存的電力分給同伴而互相學顛頻裏的帕奇利莊

candidates.english: LUXRAY’s ability to see through objects comes in handy when it’s scouting for danger.
candidates.candidate: 愉琴瞄的逶視能力 在發現急險事物時 井常有幫盼。
candidates.paddleCandidate: 倫琴福的透視能力 在發現急險事物時 非常有幫助

candidates.english: By gathering their tails together, they collectively generate powerful electricity from their claws.
candidates.candidate: 只麥與夥伴的尾巴互相 本聯，就能將更加渗大 的電擊從爪子釋放出去。
candidates.paddleCandidate: 只要與夥伴的尾巴互相串聯，就能將更加強大的電擊從爪子睜放出去

candidates.english: The extension and contraction of its muscles generates electricity. Its fur glows when it’s in trouble.
candidates.candidate: 只要忡焰飢肉躭能夠 產生電流。身陷急懷時 證毛會發出劇眼的亮光。
candidates.paddleCandidate: 只要伸缩肌肉就能夠 產生電流·身陷危機時 體毛會發出刺眼的亮光

candidates.english: When several of these POKéMON gather, their electricity can build and cause lightning storms.
candidates.candidate: 據說同一處有好幾畫的時候， 那櫻就會凝集超嘰烈的電力， 還可能逮戌閃電落於該處。
candidates.paddleCandidate: 據說同一處有好幾隻的時候， 那裡就會凝集起強烈的電力， 這可能造成閃電落於該處。

candidates.english: When sunlight reflects on the ripples created by a Bruxish grinding its teeth, the water all around sparkles brilliantly.
candidates.candidate: 癯迓時會泛起波絘〈當隅光 反射在上面時，馬輿的水會 閃起会人目眩神迷的亮光

candidates.english: It launches sticky water bubbles. Foes who lose consciousness while trapped inside these bubbles will get torn apart by Araquanid's gnashing jaws.
candidates.candidate: 等板田在水沒中的敵人失去鼐；後， 牠螟言用大颚終其咬咸碎片
candidates.paddleCandidate: 會發制點答答的水泡 等根困在水泡中的敵人失去意識後 抱戰會用大顆將其咬成碎片

candidates.english: It supports the water bubble that envelops its head with three of its legs. Sometimes it secretly swaps which legs are holding up the bubble.
candidates.candidate: 用3隻繇支报著 包裹蜩部的水淴 冇時實愉愉地換繇

candidates.english: Samurott leads its group strictly. Those who do not follow its rules receive a merciless thrashing.
candidates.candidate: 統宰群醱且性情酸格 會毫不留情炮效淵 不溫守規矩的傢比*
candidates.paddleCandidate: 統率群體且性情酸格 會毫不留情地談訓 不遵守規矩的像伙

candidates.english: Dewott has a studious and stern personality. It masters the use of its scalchops through dedicated, repeated training.
candidates.candidate: 性情勤勉 酸以律己 會残過紮實的反猹续饗 攣成燿用燜见贝的刀法
candidates.paddleCandidate: 性情動勉·髪以律己 會透過染實的反覆練習 學成後用眉見見的乃法

candidates.english: It's said that Oshawott learned to maintain its scalchop with riverbed stones by mimicking humans it saw using whetstones.
candidates.candidate: 據說牠是模仿了人類他用 毫刀石的樣子，於是裝得會用 司灘上的石頭來保蒙扇見贝。

candidates.english: It is said to have widened the seas by causing downpours. It had been asleep in a marine trench.
candidates.candidate: b說奮用障下 大雨的能力菲乐沟洋 -真沉睡在海溝的底部、
candidates.paddleCandidate: 據說會用陣下大雨的能力擁張海洋一直沉睡在海溝的能部

candidates.english: It swims grace­ fully along on the quiet, slow-moving rivers and lakes of which it is so fond.
candidates.candidate: 喜歡水流平福的 河川和潮泊 泳姿相當地優赃

candidates.english: Upon hearing its eerie howls, other POKéMON get the shivers and head straight back to their nests.
candidates.candidate: 聽見抱恐佑長嚎的 寶可必會渾身發抖， 一濯經地回别自己的巢裡。
candidates.paddleCandidate: 麗見抱恐怖長爆的 實可參會淵身發抖 一張煙地回到自己的巢裡

candidates.english: It uses different kinds of cries for communicating with others of its kind and for pursuing its prey.
candidates.candidate: 聯絡黟伴釉追婬骠物 的時候，會分別級出 不同種類的呵覺。
candidates.paddleCandidate: 聯結夥伴和連經重物的時候，會分別發出不同種類的叫響

candidates.english: The fur covering this Pokémon's body never burns, no matter what. It can shrug off any kind of fire attack.
candidates.candidate: 迦受任伺火焰攻聚 都能安然無悉。
candidates.paddleCandidate: 一身的毛皮絹不會披點燃 盡受任何火焰攻擊 都能安然無恙

candidates.english: The fire that spouts from its back burns hottest when it is angry. The flaring flames intimidate foes.
candidates.candidate: 從背上噴出的火焰會在 生氠時燃燒得最強烈， 令歎手大膳一雞。
candidates.paddleCandidate: 從背上嘆出的火焰會在生氣時燃燒得最強烈·令歌手大嚇一跳

candidates.english: It fluffs out its fur collar to cool down its body temperature, which can reach 1,650 degrees Fahrenheit.
candidates.candidate: 會震關頭部膨鬆的體乏， 使上升到了900度的 體酒能夠冷卻下來。
candidates.paddleCandidate: 會震閒頭部能經的體毛便上升到了900度的體温能夠冷卻下来

candidates.english: This mischief-loving Pokémon is full of curiosity. It battles by drawing out the type-based energy contained within its masks.
candidates.candidate: 喜歌惡作劇，好奇心旺竖。 能澂發出函具蘊踱的 屬性的能量來戰門。
candidates.paddleCandidate: 喜歡慈作劇·好奇心旺盛 能激發出面具磕碰的 麗性的能量來戰鬥

candidates.english: It prefers cool, dark places, such as the back of a shelf or the space beneath a home's floorboards. It wanders in search of prey after sunset.
candidates.candidate: 喜歡待在民笔的地板下或 架子深處等障凉的地方。 日落後會四處徘徂尋找獵物。
candidates.paddleCandidate: 喜歡待在民宅的地板下或 架子深處等險凉的地方。 日落後會四處徘徊暴找驕物。

candidates.english: Poltchageist looks like a regional form of Sinistea, but it was recently discovered that the two Pokémon are entirely unrelated.
candidates.candidate: 遊篜逃種寶可蔘看起来像是 來悲茶的地區彩態，忸疊近 被發羽其霬兩者毫無關练。
candidates.paddleCandidate: 雖然這種實可夢看起來像是來悲萊的地區形顆，但最近被發現其實雨者毫無關係。

candidates.english: The trio is together from birth. It constantly gathers honey from flowers to please VESPIQUEN.
candidates.candidate: 從出生那時起號是3隻一起。 為了取悅整女王， 一直都在探集著花蜜。
candidates.paddleCandidate: 從出生那時起就是3隻一起 為了敬愷修女王， 一直都在採集著花蜜

candidates.english: There is a village that hosts a contest based on the amazingly variable cries of this Pokémon.
candidates.candidate: 翥村子奮讓牠們互相 比拼雙化多謝的且聲， 當成娛樂活鸚。

candidates.english: When its antennae hit each other, it sounds like the music of a xylophone.
candidates.candidate: 觸角之開互相碰撞時， 會叮叮哆哆炮奏出 如同水琴一般的音色。

candidates.english: It violently flutters its wings to scatter toxic dust when attacked. It becomes active after sunset.
candidates.candidate: 受剥吱擊時會猛烈地 擇動趨帥撒出劇毒的稅末， 太陽下山後鯇會開始活動。
candidates.paddleCandidate: 受到襲擊時會猛烈增 握動超閥撤出劇車的粉束 太陽下山後就會開始活動

candidates.english: It never forgets any attack it endured while in the cocoon. After evolution, it seeks payback.
candidates.candidate: 紞算進化了也不會忘記 持在蘭中陪受到的攻擊。 一定會設法建行蝦復。
candidates.paddleCandidate: 就算進化了也不會忘記 持在端中時受到的攻擊。 一定會設法進行報復。

candidates.english: It has an aggressive nature. It stabs prey with its long, narrow mouth to drain the prey’s fluids.
candidates.candidate: 吸取對手的體液。 具有很強的攻擊性。
candidates.paddleCandidate: 會用細長的嘴刺向到手· 吸啟對手的體液· 具有很强的攻擊性

candidates.english: It drinks dew that collects on its silk and waits for evolution. Its hard cocoon repels attacks.
candidates.candidate: 會喝綠悠上掛著的朗露， 持績等待迄化的隋刻來臨。 堅硬的蘭能夠防禦攻擊。
candidates.paddleCandidate: 會喝絲線上掛著的朝露·持續等待進化的時刻來臨·堅硬的麵能夠防禦攻擊

candidates.english: It lives among the tall grass and in forests. It repels attacks by raising up the spikes on its rear.
candidates.candidate: 棲息在淼林烈草蒸裡。 受到敵人的成擊帶， 會用尾部的毒劇來型抗。
candidates.paddleCandidate: 棲息在森林和草壺裡 受到敵人的驅擊時 會用尾部的毒刺來對抗
